title: Associate Product Manager / Product Manager – GST & Compliance (CA Preferred)
description:
**Company Description**

**About the Company -**

(https://www.mastersindia.co/)

Masters India IT Solutions is a growing **B2B SaaS Product Company**, serving over 1500+ large enterprises. We are proud to be **Great Place To Work – Certified™**, reflecting our commitment to building a positive, growth-oriented workplace culture.

Masters India is one of the biggest GST Suvidha Providers (GSP) appointed by the Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN) of the Government of India since 2017. Our mission is to build intuitive software solutions that simplify complex challenges faced by businesses across industries. We are fulfilling this mission by offering tax and financial automation products to enterprises.

Masters India IT Solutions is part of the 45-year-old Masters India Group, which has a diversified presence across Manufacturing, Healthcare, Hospitality, and IT, with an aggregate turnover of INR 1000+ Crores.

 **Job Description**

**Role Overview**

**We are looking for a Chartered Accountant (CA) with hands-on experience in Product Management to build the strategy, roadmap, discovery and execution of our GST and e-invoicing platform.**

**This role sits at the intersection of tax regulations, finance operations and technology. You will be responsible for translating evolving statutory requirements and real-world taxpayer challenges into scalable, intuitive and technology-led SaaS products.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Regulatory & Product Planning**

* **Bring GST and Compliance expertise to product development, so that features are accurate, follow the law and are ready for regulatory changes on time.**

**Track GST Council decisions, CBIC/GSTN notifications and IRP/NIC changes, and turn them into product initiatives delivered ahead of compliance deadlines.**

* **Help prioritise initiatives based on customer impact, business value, regulatory urgency and technical feasibility.**
* **Spot market gaps and customer needs across enterprises, ERP ecosystems, GSPs/ASPs, tax practitioners and CA firms.**

**Domain Ownership**

* **Own the functional understanding of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2A/2B, GSTR-9/9C, ITC reconciliation, e-invoicing and e-way bills.**
* **Translate law, rules and notifications into clear requirements, business rules, validations and user workflows.**
* **Define reconciliation logic and exception handling that improve accuracy, cut manual effort and reduce compliance risk.**

**Discovery & Execution**

* **Talk to customers, finance teams and CAs to understand workflows and pain points; validate ideas through prototypes and feedback.**
* **Identify AI and automation opportunities such as invoice data extraction, anomaly detection and reconciliation assistance.**
* **Write PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria and test scenarios; work with engineering on APIs, ERP integrations and system workflows.**
* **Lead UAT and functional validation to ensure regulatory accuracy and quality before release.**

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Must-Have**

* **Educational Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) with a demonstrated transition into Product Management.**
* **Domain Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Indian indirect tax, particularly GST law and processes, GST returns, ITC reconciliation, e-invoicing and e-way bills. Exposure to GSP/ASP ecosystems, GSTN, IRP and NIC APIs**
* **Product experience: Hands-on experience across the product lifecycle (discovery, requirements, launch, iteration), ideally in compliance, tax-tech or fintech SaaS.**
* **Documentation: Clear PRDs, user stories, functional specs and test scenarios.**
* **Technical understanding: Working knowledge of APIs, integrations and ERP/accounting platforms; comfortable working with engineers.**
* **Data & communication: Uses data and customer insights to make decisions; communicates well across engineering, business, customer success and leadership.**
* **Prior experience in tax advisory, statutory audit, finance operations or enterprise compliance before transitioning into Product Management**

**Good to Have**

* **Experience building AI-enabled products or features, with an understanding of AI capabilities and their application in compliance and finance workflows.**
* **Experience working with enterprise customers and ERP ecosystems such as SAP, Oracle and Tally.**
* **Understanding of data security, privacy, regulatory compliance and enterprise SaaS requirements.**

 **Qualifications**

**Chartered Accountant (CA) with a passion for Product Management**

 **Additional Information**

**Job Location:** Procapitus Business Park, D Block, Sector 63, Noida  
**Type:** Permanent, Onsite (5 Days)

**Notice Period:** Immediate -30 days  
  
**Industry:** IT Product

title: International IP & Contracts Paralegal
description:
**Location: Hosur or Noida, India**

Global Water Solutions (GWS), one of the world’s leading manufacturers of pressure vessels, water enhancement and smart tap products, is looking for an organised, detail-oriented and proactive **International IP & Contracts Paralegal** to support our growing international business.

As GWS continues to expand globally, we are looking for an experienced professional to take ownership of the day-to-day administration and coordination of our international trademark portfolio, alongside contract and NDA management.

Working closely with GWS management, internal departments and external legal advisers across multiple jurisdictions, you will ensure our intellectual property is properly protected, legal documentation is accurately maintained and important deadlines, renewals and contractual obligations are effectively managed.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with IP and legal administration experience who enjoys working independently and coordinating international legal matters within a dynamic global business.

**Key responsibilities**

**Intellectual Property & Trademark Management**

* Maintain and manage GWS's global trademark register, covering ownership, registrations, classes, territories, status, deadlines, renewals, legal advisers and associated costs.
* Coordinate trademark filings through BOIP and the WIPO Madrid System, working with regional law firms on direct national applications where required.
* Manage trademark renewals, assignments, recordals and evidence-of-use requirements.
* Prepare and coordinate powers of attorney, declarations of authority, approval letters, filing instructions, supporting evidence and translations.
* Monitor office actions and provisional refusals, coordinating responses with internal stakeholders and external legal advisers, ensuring legal and commercial decisions are escalated appropriately and deadlines are met.
* Coordinate preliminary trademark searches and trademark watch notices with external counsel and relevant business teams.
* Maintain accurate filing records and provide a monthly management dashboard covering portfolio status, upcoming deadlines, risks and legal expenditure.

  

**Contracts & Legal Administration**

* Conduct initial reviews of contracts and NDAs using approved templates and guidelines, identifying deviations and referring substantive legal issues to qualified legal counsel.
* Manage the complete NDA process for suppliers and customers, including preparation from approved templates, internal approvals, signatures, document storage and expiry or renewal tracking.
* Maintain organised contract records and confidentiality documentation.
* Coordinate legal documentation and approvals with GWS management and internal departments, including Marketing, Finance and HR.
* Liaise with GWS legal colleagues and external lawyers across Taiwan, China, the United States, Luxembourg/Benelux and other international jurisdictions.

  

**Requirements & experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Law or a related discipline. A paralegal or intellectual property qualification would be an advantage.
* Approximately 3–7 years of relevant experience in trademark administration, intellectual property portfolio management, legal operations, contract administration or within an IP law firm.
* Practical knowledge of BOIP, WIPO/Madrid System filings, trademark classifications, renewals, office actions and provisional refusals is strongly preferred.
* Experience coordinating with international law firms, trademark agents and external legal advisers.
* Strong English drafting and communication skills, with excellent attention to detail.
* Highly organised, discreet and capable of independently managing multiple deadlines across different jurisdictions.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office and document management systems.
* Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and external advisers across different countries and time zones.

  

**Why join GWS?**

At GWS, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of an important international function within a growing global business. Working closely with senior management and legal professionals across multiple countries, you will play a key role in protecting GWS's intellectual property and supporting its international commercial activities.

We offer a dynamic and friendly working environment where initiative, accountability and collaboration are valued. This is an opportunity to develop your international IP and legal operations expertise while making a meaningful contribution to the business.

**How to Apply:**

  

* Please visit the Global Water Solutions company website, go to the careers section, and apply for the position through our BambooHR platform. https://globalwater.bamboohr.com/careers/

  

Last, but not least, if you’re curious to learn more about Global Water Solutions, feel free to visit our company website and LinkedIn page linked below.

Global Water Solutions

LinkedIn

Multifunction Smart Taps & Filtered Water - Quatreau

  

We look forward to meeting you! **Global Water Solutions** **- Where Water Gets Better**

Be responsible for compliance with secretarial standards and applicable law; specifically, the Companies Act and the Foreign Exchange Management Ac

Being a Sincher is all about learning and being in pursuit of new challenges. **EY – GDS Consulting – Enterprise Risk (ER) – Regulatory Compliance – CSV - Veeva -** **Senior**

  

As part of our EY – ER - Regulatory Compliance team, you will help the clients by understanding their business needs and delivering solutions in accordance with the EY guidelines & methodologies. As a Regulatory Compliance Senior actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. In line with our commitment to quality, you will consistently drive projects to completion with high quality deliverables, achieve operational efficiency, proactively identify and raise risks with the client as well as EY senior management team and lead internal initiatives.

**The Opportunity**

  

We are seeking an experienced Senior Consultant (Validation/Tester – Veeva) to lead validation, testing activities and compliance across various Veeva modules, regulated and business critical computerized systems for global pharmaceutical clients. The ideal candidate will ensure compliance with global regulatory standards (FDA, EMA, MHRA) and drive strategic initiatives for business process transformation and operational excellence.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

  

* Define CSA/CSV strategy in collaboration with Governance & Vaidation Lead and risk-based validation approach for the Veeva Vault platform, balancing modern CSA principles (critical thinking, risk-based test coverage) with CSV rigor where required for specific vaults/regulatory contexts.
* Perform risk assessments on platform changes (configuration, integration, releases) to determine appropriate validation rigor and evidence requirements per change.
* Define validation/testing evidence requirements in partnership with the QA Engineer role — ensuring test coverage decisions are risk-justified and audit-defensible.
* Review and approve validation deliverables (validation plans, risk assessments, test evidence, validation summary reports) before closure.
* Ensure platform changes comply with applicable regulations (21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5) and internal Computerized System Validation policies.
* Provide compliance guidance to internal Leads and vendor team members on how CSA principles apply to specific configuration/integration scenarios.
* Support internal/external audits and health authority inspections — act as the platform's validation SME during inspection readiness and response.
* Partner with QA/Change Management to ensure Change Control records carry appropriate validation justification and evidence.
* Stay current on evolving CSA guidance (e.g., FDA's CSA draft guidance) and industry practice, advising the CoE on policy updates.

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biotechnology, Engineering, or related field.
* 5+ years in CSV within the pharmaceutical, life sciences or consulting organizations.
* Comfortable working with distributed teams across India, Prague, and US time zones.
Strong influencing skills to drive practice change (CSV* CSA) across a delivery team that includes multiple other vendor roles.

  

**Must-Have Skills & Attributes**

  

* 5+ years of experience in Computer System Validation, with demonstrated leadership transitioning teams from traditional CSV to CSA practices.
* Deep knowledge of GAMP 5 (2nd edition), FDA CSA guidance, 21 CFR Part 11, and EU Annex 11.
* Experience defining risk-based testing/validation strategies that reduce documentation/testing burden without compromising compliance.
* Experience validating cloud/SaaS platforms (Veeva Vault experience strongly preferred) in a GxP environment.
* Experience supporting regulatory inspections/audits as a validation SME.
* Strong stakeholder influencing skills — this role must drive adoption of CSA thinking across delivery teams (Configuration, Integration, QA) who may default to legacy CSV habits.
* Experience partnering with QA/Test Automation teams to align risk assessments with automated test coverage decisions.

  

**Good-to-Have Skills & Attributes**

  

* Prior experience specifically validating Veeva Vault implementations (any vault — Clinical, RIM, QMS, Safety, Medical, CRM).
* Experience building or updating an organization's CSA policy/SOP framework.
* Experience with Veeva Vault QMS/QualityDocs as the vehicle for validation documentation.
* ISPE GAMP 5 training/certification

  

**Preferred Certifications**

  

* Certified Software Quality Engineer (CSQE), Certified Software Quality Assurance (CSQA)
* Information Security or Risk Management certifications.
* Any Veeva Quality certification.

  

**What we look for**

  

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.

  

**What working at EY offers**

  

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
